mentions.name: UnlistedJobs
mentions.description: A job board app where job seekers, not employers, are the paying customers. This model enables features other job platforms can't offer, such as tagging postings whose salary is one standard deviation below the average or flagging that a job has been posted multiple times already.
mentions.problem: Employer-paid job boards limit what can be disclosed to job seekers, such as flagging below-average salaries or repeatedly reposted listings.
mentions.audience: Job seekers, who are the paying customers rather than employers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building out some interesting features on my app (UnlistedJobs). Basically I have job seekers as paying customers (not employers) so I can do things with the job listings that others can't - like tag a job posting if it is 1 standard deviation below the avg salary or "this job has been posted N times already."
